scope: Real translation::run scheduling with deliberately absent models/runtime and existing deterministic literal translations. No generated translation, model benchmark or release qualification.

observed_failures.original_result: Two oldest substantive sources remained pending after runtime admission failed. Across eight bounded batches, with two new AND captions appended per subsequent batch, the newest literals succeeded but sources 3 through 10 never entered the selected batch.

The first patch selected a circular backlog pair but sorted it back into sequence order. Starting after source 9, an actual missing-runtime failure ended each batch after one substantive attempt; source 10 was skipped through twelve batches despite newest literal progress.

change.selection: Reserve two slots for newest pending captions and rotate two older slots after the last actually attempted backlog sequence. Preserve circular order at wraparound; the existing selected-batch execution rotation remains.
change.cursor: One meeting-local translation-backlog-turn-v1 dependency containing run, mode and sequence. Only an actual backlog turn advances it, after existing cancellation and batch-budget checks. Newest captions and unattempted selected passages do not advance it.
change.scope_and_invalidation: Run or translation-mode mismatch and malformed cursor data start from the oldest pending work. Meetings remain isolated; deletion clears the dependency and restoring a meeting does not restore it.
change.source_protection: The cursor is scheduling metadata only. Translation environment keys, partial-result keys, current-source/revision checks, terminology and actor checks, and commit validation are unchanged.

unchanged_budgets.time_budget_note: Existing elapsed-work checks and worker-startup exclusion remain; this is not a new hard per-request deadline.

verification.real_run_regressions: Both original failing regressions pass in core-final.log. Newest literal captions remain available, the previously starved middle literals progress, and the one-attempt wraparound test visits every old source including 10.
verification.no_model_control: Each fairness regression uses an isolated missing model/runtime directory and asserts inference_pool starts == 0. Literal text is produced by the existing AND-to-和 path, not mocked model completions.
additional_controls: Zero through twelve pending sources preserve the four-passage bound and inclusion of the two newest sources
Backlog rotation, wraparound, run/mode mismatch and malformed cursor handling
Meeting isolation and deletion/restoration clear the scheduling cursor
Revising a completed AND source to OR invalidates the old visible translation and commits only the new revision
verification.intermediate_translation_suite: 50 passed before the independently identified wraparound regression; not the final acceptance result
verification.independent_review: Wraparound failure reproduced and repaired; final review found no remaining P1/P2 within this change.

limits: These bounded producer tests demonstrate scheduling progress for the stated failure cases, not generated translation quality, proper-name accuracy or a general latency guarantee.
No new model inference, GPU execution, energy measurement or installer build was performed for this fairness evaluation. No CPU, memory, throughput or speed improvement is claimed.
Batch selection still reads the existing snapshot and pending history. This change does not complete P1.3 incremental storage or remove translation-enabled full-history reads.
